text:
Lina: Heads-up — Sam reported his July paycheck shows CA state tax and two 401(k) deductions after he moved to OR on 2026-06-15. Can someone from payroll audit and advise next steps?
Alex: I can take a look, can you drop Sam's employee ID?
Lina: Emp ID 987654. I also uploaded the relocation confirmation to the HR portal.
Sam: Confirmed — moved 6/15, updated address in self‑service. July net was negative after what looked like duplicate 401k. Really need this fixed before tax season.
Alex: Scanning the payroll runs now. Quick note: offcycle and regular run both show 401k deduction code PRTC-401. Might be a duplicate hook on the offcycle reversal from June.
Maria: @Lina thanks for flagging. @Alex can you ask the payroll audit bot to run a state allocation + deduction audit for 987654? I’ll prep an off-cycle refund if needed.
payroll-bot: Audit job started for employee 987654 — checks: state allocation, retirement deductions, last 3 payruns. ETA ~2m.
payroll-bot: Audit results: 1) Pay period 2026-07-15 assigned state=CA (expected OR starting 2026-06-15). 2) 401k code PRTC-401 applied twice on 2026-07-15 (regular + offcycle). 3) Withholding amounts: CA withheld $412, OR withheld $0 for July pay.
Maria: Got it. Root cause seems to be the offcycle that ran to move pay and also re-applied elective deductions — the state change didn't persist to the regular cycle. We'll reverse the duplicate 401k entry and queue an off-cycle refund for Sam's 401k overwithhold and CA tax withholding.
Alex: For the W-2 treatment — do we plan to split wages by state for 2026 wages? Sam moved midyear so we should allocate wages through 6/14 to CA and 6/15+ to OR, correct?
Maria: Correct. We'll set state wages split in payroll ledger: CA wages = paydates up to 2026-06-14, OR wages = from 2026-06-15 onward. Payroll will produce a single W-2 for federal and a two-state allocation on state fields. If withholding correction changes after filing, we'll issue W-2c.
Lina: Please CC People Ops when you submit the offcycle and the ticket so I can update Sam. Also remind him to keep residency docs in the portal.
Sam: I uploaded lease and OR driver's license to the HR portal last week — let me know if you need them again.
Maria: I see the docs, thanks. I've created ticket PAY-2489 and added audit output, attachments, and plan: reverse duplicate deduction, issue offcycle refund, correct state allocation, update year‑to‑date wage allocation. Target: offcycle refund processed by EOD Fri and W‑2 prep flagged for Q4.
Alex: Thx. For completeness, I'll add a note to the payroll run template so future midyear moves don't reapply deductions during the reconciliation offcycle.
Lina: Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
Sam: Thanks everyone — waiting on the refund confirmation. :slightly_smiling_face:
